merge.done_criteria: the page opens in a browser, shows the source and the time it was fetched, shows seven days with the current temperature and humidity in the middle and today's curve, and a failed request shows an error state naming the source with no made-up numbers
merge.acceptance_predicate: all ten files exist and parse, no file holds an API key, and the page requests nothing but the two named API hosts
merge.expected_outputs: site/index.html, site/styles.css, site/sources.js, site/openmeteo.js, site/cwa.js, site/normalize.js, site/now.js, site/week.js, site/chart.js, site/app.js

close_out.scope: ten modules in site/ — index.html, styles.css, sources.js, openmeteo.js, cwa.js, normalize.js, now.js, week.js, chart.js, app.js, one file each.
